task_identity_rule: TV IDs group verification proposals, not new canonical obligations. Original IDs remain in claims.jsonl. Preserve original prerequisites and current exact owners.
allocation_rule: TV01 provenance first; ready TV02-15 finite checks may proceed independently with exact-file/output isolation. TV16/17 dependencies govern the corresponding cleanup/acceptance, not a blanket barrier. Held preparation and unresolved policy do not block disjoint checks.
economy_rule: Recheck least expensive supported reliable model/effort for every finite dispatch. Extraction may be Luna medium; full cross-file judgments remain risk-matched Sol medium/high. No delegated implementation is started.

tasks.title: Make discovery and provenance honest before adding tests
tasks.producer: Owning scripts, tsconfig emit, fixture staging, pinned source and generated assets.
tasks.actual_consumer: Unmodified package/root command selection and exact installed/native entry.
tasks.independent_oracle: Independent expected file/case list plus immutable source/fixture/toolchain hashes; historical receipt scope.
negative_witnesses: Co-located Identity auth test omitted by dist/test-only selection.
Missing emitted Values string fixture must remain red; a wrongly loaded stale asset/source must fail identity.
tasks.readiness_gate: Later execution requires human release, current exact owners and private emit/output roots; no compiler writes.
tasks.observable_acceptance: Every credited case is demonstrably selected by the named command. Red/excluded tests stay explicit. Source-to-output correspondence is recorded independently.
tasks.acceptance_limit: Selection, freshness and receipt identity only; no new semantic acceptance or automatic replay of unchanged accepted gates.

economical_model.reason: Finite command/glob/source reconciliation; escalate only an actual source/evidence conflict. Luna medium may extract specified manifests.

tasks.title: Calibrate comparators using actual observation mutations
tasks.producer: Work caller errors, registered Rust observations and owning schedule callback trace.
tasks.actual_consumer: The exact comparison invoked by the test/differential runner.
tasks.independent_oracle: Frozen donor core and extra key names; full extra values require separately captured original owner evidence. Callback demand/effect contract must be independently authorized.
negative_witnesses: Remove/change actual retryable, fields or conflict; alter actual own-key sequence.
Reverse actual callback demand, throw at first/second callback, mutate actual native keys/code/random observations.
tasks.readiness_gate: Keep explicitly finite native projection separate. Resolve required error/demand-order authority before broadening a comparator.
tasks.observable_acceptance: Each required-channel mutant fails the same comparator that accepts the real producer. Expected-versus-expected notDeepEqual is not counted as calibration.
tasks.acceptance_limit: No new order policy; sorted derivation-set evidence remains valid. Default Cargo count is not the explicit ignored differential invocation.

economical_model.reason: Cross-file comparator, evaluation-order and fault-profile judgments can otherwise create false passes.

tasks.title: Separate independent arithmetic and representation oracles
tasks.producer: Values public codec/arithmetic/prepared validator, structural binding and owning stdlib exports.
tasks.actual_consumer: Actual public operations and separately staged native/protected consumers.
tasks.independent_oracle: Bounded pinned Decimal.js numerical outcomes, direct BigInt/digit-string formulas, literal coef/scale/wire bytes and independent export/type frontier.
negative_witnesses: Numerically equal wrong scale/coefficient; paired decoder/encoder error; wrong required field.
Keep lone-surrogate, astral-cut mismatch, forged/retired owner and native excluded domains visible.
tasks.readiness_gate: Required-behavior authority owns compatibility changes. Protected/native consumer prerequisites remain original A/V tasks.
tasks.observable_acceptance: Tests identify which independent oracle protects each channel. Shared-core prepared/legacy agreement is labeled preservation. Original mismatches are retained.
tasks.acceptance_limit: No full codec/validation authority or 139-operation semantic acceptance from roundtrip, scaffold or assembly pins.

economical_model.reason: Exact arithmetic, UTF16 and representation/provenance seams need source-aware independent judgment.

tasks.title: Prove actual backend selection, failure and filesystem observation
tasks.producer: Preparation conformance CLI/host runner and mutated fixture bytes.
tasks.actual_consumer: Child command through supported completion/result envelope and named filesystem domain.
tasks.independent_oracle: Executed path/backend identity, independently hashed actual inputs, owned-tree before/after inventory and UTF8 byte lengths.
negative_witnesses: Success-looking stdout followed by timeout/hang must fail.
Backend label with identical invocation must not earn native credit.
Different input mutations, overwrite/unrelated write and non-ASCII output must change relevant receipts.
tasks.readiness_gate: Preparation/native release is human-held. Source review/schema planning may proceed; no native execution or adoption now.
tasks.observable_acceptance: Nonnumeric timeout error cannot map to success; evidence distinguishes selected backend, actual input identity and exact observed side-effect domain.
tasks.acceptance_limit: No global no-effects guarantee, native parity or new resource-limit policy; frozen 153-module vectors differ legitimately from current 161-module graph.

economical_model.reason: Runner identity, timeouts and observation domains are consequential evidence joins; Luna medium can index specified receipts.

tasks.title: Test reviewed-byte refusal through the real API
tasks.producer: Actual stage/review artifacts and retained publication records.
tasks.actual_consumer: verifyReviewed/publish and the writer that receives bytes.
tasks.independent_oracle: Previously reviewed digest and independently captured writer inputs; owning reviewed-byte contract.
negative_witnesses: Same-length and changed-length tamper after review; later reread must not silently pass unreviewed bytes.
A hash-only drift comparison cannot count as refusal evidence.

tasks.observable_acceptance: Call the real refusal boundary; changed bytes are rejected before required writer effects under the selected contract.
tasks.acceptance_limit: No publication/deployment authorization and no filesystem transaction guarantee from this plan.

economical_model.reason: Reviewed-byte consumer/TOCTOU boundary needs cross-file source and effect review.

tasks.title: Add decisive identity race and admission witnesses
tasks.producer: OAuth code store/PKCE parser and exported owner/cascade routines.
tasks.actual_consumer: Actual owning store transition/token parser; mounted route remains separate.
tasks.independent_oracle: Independent RFC-derived shape/well-known vectors and owning single-use/last-owner/partial-effect requirements.
negative_witnesses: Barrier two reads then exchange: one mint, loser refuses; mint fault after consume.
Valid-alphabet 44-char challenge, illegal/missing verifier follow the owning contract.
Two owners concurrently remove each other; inject each cascade failure.
tasks.readiness_gate: Confirm supported store and product/public/persisted authority first; do not infer production team caller or select transaction mechanism.
tasks.observable_acceptance: Required one-winner/remaining-owner outcomes and defined failure/retry effects are independently observed; wrong PKCE fails before consume.
tasks.acceptance_limit: Source-derived interleavings are unexecuted. Sequential replay/last-owner guards stay credited; no blanket authentication bypass claim.

economical_model.reason: Security/authority races and contract admission need focused high reasoning; persisted-policy changes require separate critical review.

tasks.producer: Real identity/session/grant, emitted app and canonical invoker/State guard.
tasks.actual_consumer: Selected mounted Worker/HTTP/MCP route through durable effect.
tasks.independent_oracle: Independent membership/expiry snapshots and persisted rows/history/outbox/receipts for the selected operation.
negative_witnesses: Revoke/expire after live admission but before effect.
Wrong audience/principal/role/Origin and replayed presession refuse in the agreed effect domain.
tasks.readiness_gate: Actual emitter, SDK/host and identity+commit binding; preserve safe-message parity and real State transaction tests.
tasks.observable_acceptance: Real route and act-time guard demonstrate required refusal before the owning effect; handcrafted permission doubles remain labeled.
tasks.acceptance_limit: No cross-store restart or all-app acceptance. This does not invalidate real D1/DO constraints, dispatch fences or granted tools/list.

economical_model.reason: Authority must be checked across producer, route and effect rather than helper-only assertions.

tasks.title: Verify CSV selection and consent through independent row identities
tasks.producer: Shared grammar, public UI review and HTTP commit/consent mapping.
tasks.actual_consumer: Real selected rows into State replay and effect.
tasks.independent_oracle: Literal independent headers/cells/malformed outcomes and Node SHA over agreed canonical consent bytes; independent source-row identity.
negative_witnesses: Invalid/blank/duplicate reorder cannot silently select a different row under the same consent.
Changed valid data conflicts; same real replay has one effect.
Parse-first 1001 rows plus malformed tail remains the current profile unless authority changes.

tasks.observable_acceptance: Selected row identity, reviewed consent and committed effect agree under replay; wrapper agreement is labeled shared-implementation evidence.
tasks.acceptance_limit: No new grammar/early-limit policy and no deletion of legacy pins based solely on common implementation.

economical_model.reason: Grammar alone is bounded; consent/row-selection/replay join carries identity and effect risk.

tasks.acceptance_limit: No 68-binder/full browser policy adoption from three binder fixtures or HappyDOM helper tests.
